library_of_congress.title: The Invisible Host
library_of_congress.author: leslie s. klinger, gwen bristow, bruce manning
library_of_congress.description: This novel is a chilling locked room thriller which traps eight dinner guests in a New Orleans penthouse with a host who communicates only by radio as the party is killed one by one.

library_of_congress.title: Voices of the Early Americas
library_of_congress.author: library of congress
library_of_congress.description: This book puts varied items from the Jay I. Kislak Collection of the Archaeology and History of the Early Americas—ancient objects, colonial and modern paintings, books, manuscripts, and maps—in conversation with other materials from the Library of Congress, including contemporary photography and poetry.

library_of_congress.title: Speaking of America
library_of_congress.author: david m. rubenstein
library_of_congress.description: Featuring interviews with eminent historians, journalists, and writers, this book brings together nineteen wide-ranging conversations from philanthropist and financier David M. Rubenstein’s long-running Congressional Dialogues series of interviews at the Library of Congress. Highlights include Ken Burns on documenting American history, Stacy Schiff on Samuel Adams, and David McCullough on the American frontier.

library_of_congress.title: Sharing Food, Sharing Culture
library_of_congress.author: meg nicholas, allina migoni, stephen winick
library_of_congress.description: This book shares the wealth of cultural documentation about community-based foodways found in the collections of the American Folklife Center at the Library of Congress.

library_of_congress.title: Detective Duff Unravels It
library_of_congress.author: harvey o'higgins, leslie s. klinger
library_of_congress.description: From murder to extortion to kidnapping and more, Detective Duff unravels it all in this collection of ten short stories, using his shrewd understanding of human behavior and his expert team of operatives to pick apart even the knottiest of cases.

library_of_congress.title: Florentine Finish
library_of_congress.author: leslie s. klinger, cornelius hirschberg
library_of_congress.description: First published in 1964, this novel follows diamond salesman Saul Handy as he’s caught between the cops, the mob, a beautiful amateur jeweler, and shady gemologists.

library_of_congress.title: A Revolutionary Idea
library_of_congress.author: library of congress
library_of_congress.description: Compact, lively, and accessible, this book features archival images, historical maps, and new artwork to convey the story of the Declaration of Independence in fresh and compelling ways.

library_of_congress.title: Immigration and Migration in US History
library_of_congress.author: library of congress
library_of_congress.description: Exploring the experiences of immigration, migration, and relocation, this book in the Discover and Learn with the Library series offers instruction-ready materials for teachers, librarians, and home educators.
library_of_congress.category: discover and learn with the library of congress

library_of_congress.title: The American Revolution
library_of_congress.author: library of congress
library_of_congress.description: Exploring the many different aspects of the American Revolution, this book in the Discover and Learn with the Library series offers instruction-ready materials for teachers, librarians, and home educators.

library_of_congress.title: The Source Creative Research Journal
library_of_congress.author: library of congress
library_of_congress.description: This interactive journal contains research tips, creative prompts with space to brainstorm, and guides for exploring Library of Congress collections and your own world as you pursue your unique research projects.

library_of_congress.title: Pocket Constitution Annotated
library_of_congress.author: library of congress
library_of_congress.description: This unique pocket-size version of the U.S. Constitution contains the full text of each article and amendment, brief explanations in plain English, and QR codes that link to the Library of Congress’s online version of the Constitution of the United States of America, Analysis and Interpretation, Congress’s official record of the Constitution.

library_of_congress.title: Transient Worlds
library_of_congress.author: arthur sze
library_of_congress.description: This book is a personal guide to global poetry in translation by 25th U.S. Poet Laureate Arthur Sze. Focusing on an accessible selection of key works, Sze takes readers through nearly two millennia of poetry from every part of the world, constructing fifteen different “zones” of literary discussion.

library_of_congress.title: Tell Me a Story
library_of_congress.author: hannah freece, mac barnett
library_of_congress.description: From alphabet books to adventurous graphic novels, this book explores the Library of Congress’s American children’s literature collections dating from the colonial era to the present. It highlights both classic and award-winning books as well as lesser-known gems ready for rediscovery.
